title: SWN rules register (#1105)
intro: #1105 opens with a chapter table that says of itself: **"Statuses are preliminary file-level observations, not verified fidelity or passing tests. Agents MUST replace each with source-verified, per-rule granular rows."** This register is that replacement. It is an audit, not a completion certificate, and SWN remains the one Without Number system whose *text* this repository may not use.

statuses.implemented: Code and a test that exercises it are both present in this repository.
statuses.partial: Some of the procedure exists; the row states what is missing.
statuses.verified_reuse: The published procedure is satisfied by delegating to an already-verified subsystem, usually CWN.
statuses.missing: No implementation. The default, and it needs no justification.
statuses.blocked: Cannot be done from the sources and rights available to agents.
statuses.not_applicable: Explicitly ruled out, with the decision recorded.

fidelities.verified: Compared against a readable copy of the published procedure by a human.
fidelities.unverified: Nobody has compared the code against the printed numbers yet. After the source index landed, this is a work statement, not a licensing obstacle.
fidelities.blocked: Cannot be verified because no readable copy exists (e.g. a book that is not in the repository and was never supplied). SWN is NOT blocked: its copy has been read and its sections recorded; rows that are not compared say 'unverified'.
fidelities.not_applicable: No published procedure to compare against (setting guidance, or a row that only delegates to CWN).

$comment: SWN's rights position is the opposite of CWN's and WWN's. CWN and WWN both publish CC0 System Reference Documents. Stars Without Number publishes a free EDITION OF THE BOOK, not an SRD, and docs/licenses/ISSUE_569_WITHOUT_NUMBER_RIGHTS.md records that no applicable text licence has been established. data/sources/game_system_rights.json carries the verdict 'blocked-unverified'. What that permits is real but narrow: independently written procedural implementations of unprotected mechanics. What it forbids is verbatim names, tables, prose, art and setting. Every existing src/rules/swn_*.py module is self-described as 'SWN-inspired' or an 'Original NoöPunk implementation' for exactly this reason, and that is why every SWN-native row below carries fidelity 'unverified' rather than 'verified'.

swn_revised.note: Author-supplied copy of the book, read on 2026-11-03 and section-indexed into data/rules/swn_sections.json (titles and printed pages only). Reading and citing pages is permitted to repository agents; reproducing its text, tables, art or setting is not. No applicable text licence exists (#569).

swn_reference_code.note: Not a drop-in Python library. Licence must be assessed per file before anything is ported, with attribution and verified parity. Nothing has been ported.

cwn_srd.document: Cities Without Number System Reference Document
cwn_srd.note: Primary human-scale rules. SWN rows reuse it by delegation rather than reimplementing it.

rows.tabletop: CWN character creation is the baseline; SWN does not replace it for ordinary humans.
rows.notes: The constitution sets CWN as the primary character-scale game for humans. This row delegates rather than duplicating.

rows.subsystem: Psychic and Partial Psychic class packages
rows.tabletop: Psychic advancement as published, on top of CWN character creation.
rows.notes: Progression mechanics exist as an original implementation. The class package as a whole (eligibility, foci interaction, partial-psychic split) is not verified against the book.

rows.subsystem: Alien and True AI character options
rows.notes: Deluxe character options are registered so they are not silently dropped; no text may be reproduced, but the pages are readable (p.248 onward) and the rows stay unverified until compared.

rows.subsystem: Effort accounting, commitment durations and recovery
rows.tabletop: Effort pools with active, scene and day commitments, and their recovery.
rows.notes: The module reproduces resource arithmetic only - no power names, tables or prose - because SWN has no verified SRD licence. That is a deliberate boundary, not an oversight.

rows.tabletop: Torching as a costly last resort: attributes burn and the granted point is scene-scoped. System Strain is not applied here.

rows.notes: Skill interaction is modelled where the Effort arithmetic needs it, without adding SWN skills to CWN's default list.

rows.subsystem: Six disciplines: technique inventory and effects
rows.tabletop: Provisional NoöPunk techniques over the Effort shape.
rows.notes: The Effort engine is one implementation after this pass (capacity, reservations by duration, torching, snapshot persistence), and the six discipline sections are indexed at pp.32-43. What is NOT done is the book's full per-discipline technique list: the catalogue holds the six cores and 20 authored NoöPunk techniques. Unverified, not blocked - the copy is readable.

rows.subsystem: Technique activation, targets, saves and scene state
rows.notes: Activation and application exist for the provisional catalogue, not for the published technique list.
The tracker requires delegating duplicates to CWN rather than creating a second core.

rows.subsystem: Environmental hazards: radiation, vacuum, exotic environments
rows.notes: Needed only from Phase 3, when the campaign leaves Earth.
Humans stay at CWN technology; SWN tiers belong to extraterrestrial owners. The access model is P1 work, not this row.
The module describes itself as an SWN-inspired adapter, not a complete ship catalogue. It must not be presented as published hull or fitting data.

rows.subsystem: Space combat, crew actions, damage and repair
rows.notes: Attack resolution exists; full crew action economy and repair procedures do not.

Recorded decision: this is SWN's default setting, and NoöPunk has its own canon (Zoo Hypothesis, Zookeepers, Greater Orion Arm Co-Prosperity Sphere). The tracker forbids overwriting NoöPunk canon with SWN's future history. Rows here would be setting text, which is also not licensed for reuse.

The module handles original route and fuel budgets and explicitly does not reproduce proprietary spike-drive rules. Its test lives in test_swn_space_factions.py, not under its own name — which is exactly the sort of thing a filename-based coverage claim gets wrong.
Generators are tables, and tables are exactly what the rights position excludes.

rows.subsystem: Alien stat blocks and species creation
rows.notes: Required from Phase 2 (Disclosure). NoöPunk species are its own canon; published stat tables may not be copied.

rows.subsystem: Species social lenses and NPC packages
rows.notes: The tracker requires distinct Zookeeper, Grey, Mantid and Reptilian capabilities rather than one belligerent species.

rows.tabletop: Faction statistics and income for a strategic turn.
rows.notes: The original SWN-inspired turn exists. Its own docstring warns that asset catalogues and combat tables remain reference-only.

All 68 printed assets (24 Cunning, 22 Force, 22 Wealth) are in data/rules/swn_faction_assets.json, extracted from pp.219/221/223 by tools/swn_faction_assets.py and spot-checked against the printed rows in the tests. The ~60 individual special abilities are NOT implemented: each is rules text that changes what an action may be, and the sheet tells the GM to read the entry.

rows.subsystem: Asset movement, attacks, defence and damage
rows.notes: Attack exchange verified against p.214: 1d10 + the attacking rating vs 1d10 + the defended attribute, higher wins, a tie lands both, the counterattack uses the defender's own die. Movement, stealthed targeting and the Expand Influence contest are still unmodelled.

rows.tabletop: Seeded faction turns for the strategic layer.

rows.notes: Deterministic operations layered on the turn; original NoöPunk implementation.
The tracker asks for paper play. No parallel ledgers may be introduced alongside it.
Self-described as SWN-inspired, not verified faithful. Cortical stacks and resleeving economics are a NoöPunk setting layer and must not be presented as published SWN rules.
Pivotal to the Greater Orion Arm economy in NoöPunk canon, and deliberately a setting system rather than an unexplained new PC power.

rows.subsystem: Space Magic spell and occult variants
rows.notes: Must be audited against WWN magic and SWN psi so no Effort pool is accidentally shared.
Optional, for unusually powerful beings, never standard CWN humans.
Self-described as SWN-inspired. The tracker warns against rewriting core AI policy or reading sentience from rule labels.

rows.subsystem: Alien societies, governments and species politics
rows.notes: Must tie to faction and ideology identifiers without a second faction engine.
Only when a scenario needs it; CWN normal combat must stay unaffected.

compatibility.cwn: Attribute band and skill list are the human baseline.
compatibility.wwn: Backgrounds map onto CWN; no replacement vocabulary.
compatibility.swn: Psychic skills exist only for psychic characters and are not added to CWN's default list.
compatibility.precedence: CWN for ordinary humans; SWN skills appear only inside SWN-native packages.

compatibility.cwn: CWN resolution is authoritative at human scale.
compatibility.swn: Starship and mech combat are SWN-native and must not alter CWN personal combat.
compatibility.precedence: CWN wins any genuine conflict at character scale; SWN owns its own vehicle scale.
compatibility.citation: #1105; CWN Free Edition p. 218 onward 'Mixing Sine Nomine Games Together'

compatibility.cwn: No Effort pool; System Strain is the CWN resource and is not modified.
compatibility.swn: Psychic Effort with active, scene and day commitments, plus Torching.
compatibility.precedence: The pools are separate by rule. Sharing one accidentally is a defect.

compatibility.wwn: Faction turns, assets and Major Projects.
compatibility.swn: Force, Cunning, Wealth and FacCreds, with a published asset catalogue.
compatibility.precedence: Complementary, never subsumed. SWN and WWN faction systems keep their own native scale.

compatibility.swn: SWN tiers belong to extraterrestrial owners; MJ-12 and select agencies hold secret reverse-engineered assets.
compatibility.precedence: Human play stays CWN; SWN tiers are gated by scenario and reveal stage, not granted as starting equipment.

compatibility.swn: Deluxe transhuman rules, shells and identity continuity.
compatibility.precedence: A NoöPunk setting system built on SWN-inspired mechanics; not published SWN text.

gaps: Fidelity is 'unverified' on every SWN-native row and that is not a formality: SWN publishes a free edition of the book, not a CC0 SRD, so no agent can compare the code to the text without violating the rights boundary. The tracker's demand for 'source-verified' rows cannot be met from this repository's sources, and this register says so instead of pretending.

The largest blocked item is P4: #1105 asks for every published technique, level by level, across six disciplines. The repository has 20 original, provisional techniques instead - no power names, no effect text, by design.
F2 is the largest gap in the faction workstream: a published asset catalogue is a table, and tables are excluded. Any NoöPunk asset list must be authored originally and labelled as such.
This register records that #1105's preliminary chapter table has been replaced, one row at a time. It has not been replaced by anything better than file existence plus an honest fidelity verdict.
